Community Development Commission
AGENDA
la puente Community Development Commission
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
March 25, 2008
07:00 PM
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCILMEMBERS: Mendoza, Solis, Storing, Holloway, Lujan
COMMISSIONERS: Mendoza, Solis, Storing, Holloway, Lujan
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS MEETINGS
A-1
READING OF THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF FEBRUARY 26, 2008.
That the Agency Board waive the reading and approve the Minutes as presented.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
UNFINISHED BUSINESS
CONSENT CALENDAR
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. CDC 105 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2006-07
It is recommended that the Commissioners adopt the resolution.
D-2
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY TREASURER'S/FINANCIAL REPORT FOR MONTH ENDED JANUARY 31, 2008
It is recommended that the Commission receives and files the Redevelopment Agency Treasure's/Financial Report for the month ended January 31, 2008.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF AN EXCLUSIVE NEGOTIATING AGREEMENT WITH BEVERLY WESTWOOD DEVELOPMENT COMPANY FOR PROPERTY LOCATED AT 1529-45 N. HACIENDA BOULEVARD
It is recommended that the Commission approve the Exclusive Negotiating Agreement with Beverly Westwood Development Company and authorize the Chairman to execute the agreement on its behalf
ADJOURNMENT
Copies of reports relating to items on the Agenda are available for public inspection or purchase at City Hall. Questions regarding agenda items may be addressed to the City Clerk at 626/855-1500, extension 503. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk’s Office. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements. Dated this 21st day of March, 2008.
______________________________________
Diana Giron, City Clerk
